name: W National Park and Arly (Burkina Faso)
story: W National Park and Arly are located in Burkina Faso, Niger, and Benin. The regional park covers some 10,000 km2 around a meander in the Niger River. It features wetlands, sandstone hills, and savanna, and is home to African elephants, hippos, and lions.
matters: The park provides a home for some of West Africa's last wild African elephants and is one of the last strongholds for the Northwest African cheetah.
